source_type: Official corporate announcement and government parliamentary records

source_quality.tier_A: RBI materials, government amalgamation scheme documents, DBS Bank official announcement on amalgamation
source_quality.tier_B: Credible journalism, banking-law analysis, regulatory commentary on LVB crisis

contamination_notes: DBS official announcement and Sansad/government sources are post-moratorium and describe outcome facts (amalgamation completion, moratorium lifting, customer service restoration). These must be used only in outcome.json. Input.json must be grounded in pre-moratorium stress facts available at 16 November 2020.
source_limitations: DBS official source describes outcome stage: amalgamation effective, moratorium lifted, services restored
Government Sansad Q&A describes final amalgamation scheme and outcome
No source captures the exact pre-moratorium decision-date internal management view
PCA framework details and RBI supervision correspondence are regulatory documents not fully public
Input.json relies on publicly available pre-moratorium stress signals rather than internal bank records
